prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original anime/game adult female facial-design atlas, detailed lower-face studies.
Primary request: EXACTLY sixteen distinct labeled examples, one per equal cell.
Layout: square 2048x2048 canvas, EXACTLY4 columns x4 rows, equal square cells, thin straight light-gray grid at quarter axes. Row-major left to right then down. NO heading, footer, inset, products, hands, or extra images. Only the exact cell ID, small crisp dark sans serif at its top left. No other text, no logos, no watermark.
Subject: original mature ADULT women age25-45 only. Each cell shows a calm lower-face portrait from the base of the nose to the entire chin, with cheek context. The complete mouth and both corners must stay fully within the cell with generous margins. Nonsexual editorial cosmetics/anatomy drawing, neutral resting closed lips unless specified, no tongue, exaggerated pouting or expressions. Warm neutral ivory background and soft consistent studio light.
Style: polished professional 2D anime reference drawing, clean fine outlines, subtle cel shading plus precise cosmetic sheen; believable lip volume and fine texture. Same original adult model and same scale in all cells except explicitly noted skin-tone or profile examples. Actual visible differences are essential; do not substitute identical generic lips.
Specific direction: Natural unpainted muted rose-brown lips. Cells1-13 are FRONTAL; use neutral closed mouths and distinguish morphology without facial acting. Cells14-16 are STRICT SIDE PROFILE, the whole lower nose, lips and chin visible, facing left. No makeup, gloss, liner, or cosmetic exaggeration. Compare thickness, upper/lower balance, cupid bow, central tubercle, width and resting corners exactly.
Ordered cells:
Cell1, ID LP001: balanced medium lips / 均衡中等厚唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，上下唇厚度接近，下唇稍饱满，唇峰弧度适中，作为本页基准。
Cell2, ID LP002: thin upper and lower lips / 上下轻薄唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，上下唇红区域均较窄，闭口线清楚，宽度与基准接近。
Cell3, ID LP003: full upper and lower lips / 上下饱满唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，上下唇红区域都较厚且圆润，保留自然唇缘和唇峰。
Cell4, ID LP004: thin upper full lower lip / 上薄下丰唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，上唇明显轻薄，下唇中央厚实，形成清楚的上下厚度差。
Cell5, ID LP005: full upper thin lower lip / 上丰下薄唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，上唇红区域更厚，下唇偏窄，上下比例与上一项相反。
Cell6, ID LP006: defined cupid-bow lips / 清晰双峰弓唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，上唇双峰清楚，中间V形凹口明确，唇缘边界利落。
Cell7, ID LP007: soft rounded cupid-bow lips / 圆弧柔峰唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，上唇双峰转折圆缓，中间凹口浅，形成柔和连续弧线。
Cell8, ID LP008: flat upper-lip outline / 平缓上缘唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，上唇顶部较平，双峰与中央凹口都不明显，下唇弧线自然。
Cell9, ID LP009: prominent central lip tubercle / 中央唇珠明显唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，上唇中央有小而清楚的圆润唇珠，闭口线中央轻轻向下弯。
Cell10, ID LP010: wide horizontal lips / 横向舒展宽唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，嘴角间距明显宽于基准，唇厚中等，不能用微笑拉宽来代替。
Cell11, ID LP011: compact narrow lips / 小口紧凑唇. Visible: 正面中性闭唇，嘴角间距较窄，唇缘集中在中央，厚度中等，表情不撅嘴。
Cell12, ID LP012: naturally upturned lip corners / 自然微翘嘴角唇. Visible: 正面静止闭唇，嘴角末端轻轻上翘，脸颊保持放松，区别于主动微笑。
Cell13, ID LP013: naturally downturned lip corners / 自然微垂嘴角唇. Visible: 正面静止闭唇，嘴角末端略向下，眉眼不参与，不将轮廓画成悲伤表情。
Cell14, ID LP014: subtle-projection lips in profile / 侧面浅凸唇. Visible: 严格侧面中性闭唇，鼻底到下巴完整入画，上下唇体积较浅，唇尖轻微前凸。
Cell15, ID LP015: rounded full lips in profile / 侧面圆润丰唇. Visible: 严格侧面中性闭唇，鼻底到下巴完整入画，上下唇均圆润向前，侧面体积清楚。
Cell16, ID LP016: lower-lip-forward profile / 侧面下唇略前唇. Visible: 严格侧面中性闭唇，鼻底到下巴完整入画，下唇轻微超过上唇前缘，轮廓自然克制。

Particularly differentiate finish cells10-16 using the same muted ROSE-RED base: matte has no highlights, satin broad soft reflection, mirror has crisp bright streaks, jelly is translucent, pearl evenly shimmers, metallic has foil-like bands, glitter has separate tiny points. NO products or swatches outside the lips.
Ordered cells:
Cell1, ID LM001: beige-apricot satin lips / 裸米杏缎光唇. Visible: 正面中等唇形均匀涂裸米杏色，反光柔和，唇缘清楚，保留细微唇纹。
Cell2, ID LM002: dusty-rose soft-matte lips / 玫瑰豆沙柔雾唇. Visible: 正面中等唇形为低饱和玫瑰豆沙色，表面细腻柔雾，无镜面亮斑。
Cell3, ID LM003: peach-coral dewy lips / 蜜桃珊瑚水润唇. Visible: 正面中等唇形为暖蜜桃珊瑚色，有薄薄水润光泽与自然透色感。
Cell4, ID LM004: cool berry-pink glossy lips / 冷调莓粉亮泽唇. Visible: 正面中等唇形为冷调莓粉色，下唇有清楚亮泽反射，保持粉紫底色。
Cell5, ID LM005: classic red velvet lips / 经典正红丝绒唇. Visible: 正面中等唇形均匀正红，覆盖完整，表面呈细腻丝绒哑光，边缘清楚。
Cell6, ID LM006: terracotta brick-red matte lips / 砖红陶土哑光唇. Visible: 正面中等唇形为带橘棕调的砖红陶土色，哑光饱和覆盖，区别于纯正红。
Cell7, ID LM007: caramel-cinnamon brown lips / 焦糖肉桂棕唇. Visible: 正面中等唇形为温暖肉桂焦糖棕，柔和缎光，不变成深巧克力色。
Cell8, ID LM008: deep plum-berry lips / 深梅紫浆果唇. Visible: 正面中等唇形为深梅紫与莓果色，唇峰与边界清楚，缎光反射克制。
Cell9, ID LM009: clear natural lip sheen / 透明裸色润唇. Visible: 正面自然粉棕唇，仅覆透明薄亮泽，保留原本唇色、唇纹与边缘。
Cell10, ID LM010: soft-matte lip finish / 柔雾漫反射唇. Visible: 与后续质感对照使用相同玫瑰红色和相同唇形，表面均匀柔雾，没有高亮反光点。
Cell11, ID LM011: creamy satin lip finish / 奶油缎光质感唇. Visible: 相同玫瑰红色与唇形，下唇有宽而柔的微光反射，介于哑光和明显亮泽之间。
Cell12, ID LM012: mirror-gloss lip lacquer / 镜面唇釉质感唇. Visible: 相同玫瑰红色与唇形，表面有清晰条状镜面反射，亮度集中而边缘锐利。
Cell13, ID LM013: translucent jelly lip finish / 透明果冻质感唇. Visible: 相同玫瑰红色与唇形，唇色更透，呈薄透果冻光泽，可隐约看出自然唇纹。
Cell14, ID LM014: fine pearlescent lip finish / 细珠光珍珠唇. Visible: 相同玫瑰红色与唇形，表面有细密柔和珠光，形成均匀珍珠光感而非大颗闪片。
Cell15, ID LM015: metallic foil lip finish / 金属箔光质感唇. Visible: 相同玫瑰红色与唇形，出现连续金属反光带，偏玫瑰铜色，区别于水亮唇釉。
Cell16, ID LM016: micro-glitter accented lips / 微闪亮片点缀唇. Visible: 相同玫瑰红色与唇形，少量微小亮片分散在唇面，单个反光点可辨，唇缘干净。
